responsibility: Provides the main x86 Darwin/Mach-O target configuration header. It defines the Mach-O-specific backend policy for stack alignment, PIC defaults, assembler and linker specs, debugger register mappings, Darwin builtins, section and alignment emission, profiling calls, EH address encodings, builtin initialization, and other ABI and object-format hooks that distinguish macOS x86 code generation from ELF and PE targets.
